// Requires the Neo4j APOC library
/*
:params {
    personId: 30786325588624,
    country: 'China',
    tagClass: 'MusicalArtist',
    minPathDistance: 3,
    maxPathDistance: 4
}

	relationshipFilter: "KNOWS",
    minLevel: 1,
    maxLevel: $minPathDistance-1
})
YIELD node
WITH startPerson, collect(DISTINCT node) AS nodesCloserThanMinPathDistance
CALL apoc.path.subgraphNodes(startPerson, {
	relationshipFilter: "KNOWS",
    minLevel: 1,
    maxLevel: $maxPathDistance
})
YIELD node
WITH nodesCloserThanMinPathDistance, collect(DISTINCT node) AS nodesCloserThanMaxPathDistance
// compute the difference of sets: nodesCloserThanMaxPathDistance - nodesCloserThanMinPathDistance
WITH [n IN nodesCloserThanMaxPathDistance WHERE NOT n IN nodesCloserThanMinPathDistance] AS expertCandidatePersons

MATCH
  (message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
RETURN
  expertCandidatePerson.id,
  tag.name,
  count(DISTINCT message) AS messageCount

// NeuG form of the Neo4j BI query; contains no materialized-property reads.
// Render parameters with NeuG/scripts/benchmark/render_bi_node_indexes.py.
// Uses the LDBC invariant that TAG.name uniquely identifies a tag.
MATCH(p:PERSON)
 OPTIONAL MATCH(p)-[i:HASINTEREST]->(it:TAG) WHERE it.name='Che_Guevara'
 WITH p,count(i) AS ic
 OPTIONAL MATCH(p)<-[:HASCREATOR]-(m:POST:COMMENT)-[:HASTAG]->(t:TAG)
 WHERE t.name='Che_Guevara' AND m.creationDate > TIMESTAMP('2010-06-12 00:00:00') AND m.creationDate < TIMESTAMP('2010-06-22 00:00:00')
 WITH p,ic,count(m) AS mc
 WITH p,100*ic+mc AS score WHERE score>0
 OPTIONAL MATCH(p)-[k:KNOWS]-(friend:PERSON)
 WITH p,score,friend,count(k) AS multiplicity
 OPTIONAL MATCH(friend)-[fi:HASINTEREST]->(ft:TAG) WHERE ft.name='Che_Guevara'
 WITH p,score,friend,multiplicity,count(fi) AS fic
 OPTIONAL MATCH(friend)<-[:HASCREATOR]-(fm:POST:COMMENT)-[:HASTAG]->(fmt:TAG)
 WHERE fmt.name='Che_Guevara' AND fm.creationDate > TIMESTAMP('2010-06-12 00:00:00') AND fm.creationDate < TIMESTAMP('2010-06-22 00:00:00')
 WITH p,score,friend,multiplicity,fic,count(fm) AS fmc
 WITH p,score,friend,multiplicity,100*fic+fmc AS friendScore
 RETURN p.id,score,sum(multiplicity*friendScore) AS friendsScore
 ORDER BY score+friendsScore DESC,p.id ASC LIMIT 100;
